html:
The Battle of Grand Port was fought from 20 to 27 August 1810 in the bay of Grand Port on the southeast coast of Mauritius, where a French squadron defeated a British force trying to blockade the island.

The British frigates ran aground on the coral reefs, and two were burned by their crews while two were captured. It was France's greatest naval victory of the Napoleonic Wars, the only sea battle named on the Arc de Triomphe in Paris.

It did not save the colony. In December 1810 a large British army landed in the north, and the French surrendered Port Louis. The Treaty of Paris of 1814 confirmed British rule. The French settlers kept their land, language and laws, which is why Mauritians still speak French and Creole more than English, and sugar estates stayed in French hands.
sum: The Battle of Grand Port was fought from 20 to 27 August 1810 in the bay of Grand Port on the southeast coast of Mauritius, where a French squadron defeated a British force trying to blockade the island.
